head.name: Signal Catalogue, Counted
what: large typed count figure beside the plate with brass unit and a pencilled line; or 48px title with the page's one action at the right end
Page title plate with a large typed count and unit beside it

head.name: Desk Terminal, Banded
what: larger title with the page's one lit primary action at the right end; or a ruled strip of linked counts under the head

glass.name: Desk Terminal, Railed
what: Terminal case with the question typed on the glass and a block cursor; add a one-line status on the glass

glass.name: Desk Terminal, Mapped
what: Cased tube with Vera's header, typed question, Next up and a radar map or trace; plus a status line on the glass

list.name: Track Diagram Aglow
what: dated rail with stamps at each row and a lit now node; or faint steel banding on alternate rows

list.name: Desk Terminal, Railed
what: Coming up track: NOW dot, large mono day numeral with month over weekday, time and in-N-days columns

figure.name: Desk Terminal, Joined
what: Status gauge on the glass with tick scale, lit needle and a big mono readout; or an ECG scope trace

figure.name: Long Persistence
what: due scope on To do (late spikes, now line, week divisions); or the round week dial with today lit

rule.name: Blueprint, Serif Glass
what: section rule closing in a small solid end mark in the section's colour; or sections hung from a single titled rule

rule.name: Grid Console
what: section head as a titled rule with a trailing light rail; or a small solid end block closing each rule

signal.name: Blueprint Rule Raster
what: One mono lamp line saying what Vera is doing ('Ready, nothing waiting on Vera'); a steel dot for waiting in place of red

signal.name: Desk Terminal, Mapped
what: Dot rows showing 3 of 4 on, with a lit lamp at the case's foot; a steel dot for waiting

type.name: Track Diagram Folio
what: Fraunces titles and section heads, light lining figures, small-caps units
Fraunces heads with light lining figures and small-cap units; a larger page title with the action at its end

colour.name: Desk Terminal, Banded
what: slightly cooler ground with warmer bone neutral words; walnut and brass plate material as runner

colour.name: Grid Console, Wired
what: Green-black glass, steel-slate case and thin lines in amber and violet, with the least neon in the field

controls.name: Track Diagram Weekdial
what: Select drawn as a raised button with a chevron that flips open; a clean list; bright Send key

controls.name: Blueprint Latched Tube
what: filters as latched keys with a lamp on the one that is down; or the cased terminal's segmented view and month keys

chat.name: Track Diagram Folio
what: Thread hung on a rail that opens on What's on your mind? as its first stop, with Vera's lines on nodes

chat.name: Track Diagram Aglow
what: One panel: bold question with a lit key word, composer, From, mic, bright Send, then outlined ways to start

light.name: Desk Terminal, Joined
what: Typed question in lit VT323 with halo and block cursor on a scanlined tube, glow limited to the glass

light.name: Long Persistence Tallied
what: Layered halo on the bar's mark, wordmark and current tab; phosphor wire and light trails

foot.name: Desk Terminal, Mapped
what: Phone tab bar with a steel reverse block marking the here-tab, large icons and labels

foot.name: Desk Terminal, Railed
what: terminal foot cut to lamp, state and Status link; title block cut to lamp and name
